The '''Pharmalux Waste Processing facility''' was a waste processing plant run by [[Pharmalux Technologies]] in the lower levels of the [[Lower Industrial Sector]] of the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]]. During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]], [[Agent/Legends|Agent]] [[Kalda Biss]] of the [[Republic Strategic Information Service]] led an operation that stopped the Imperial [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Vergost]] from using the facility to wipe out all of the moon's [[Evocii]] population.<ref name="Extermination" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Pharmalux Waste Processing facility appears as part of the Lower Industrial Sector on Nar Shaddaa in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[Star Wars video games|video game]] released by [[BioWare]] in [[2011]].<ref name="Extermination" />
